acceptance: Each listed prompt is exercised with closed stdin in a test and exits with a clear message and documented code, never a traceback.
run --non-interactive never reaches the orchestrator credential prompt.
publish help shows a working example.
context: Source: found on 2026-11-13 while delivering the agent-facing work (PRs BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4202, #4203 and BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site#152, #153, #154). Source table: the guard coverage survey attached to PR #4203's body. Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.
description:
Problem: several prompts are reached without a terminal and fail rather than taking a documented non-interactive path: the credential-setup Confirm.ask in benchbox/cli/orchestrator.py after a credential failure (not suppressed by run --non-interactive), setup --remove (Confirm.ask with no catch, likely a traceback), export overwrite, publish remove without --yes, and auth login or refresh without a token. Also, publish's group help shows `benchbox publish results/...json` but the command is `publish run`.

Outcome: each prompt has a non-interactive behaviour that fails cleanly with a message and documented exit code, or proceeds only with an explicit flag.
